texts.as_from_device: Byasubirijwe kuri iki gikoresho, bivuye mu bufasha bwabitswe ku wa {date}.
texts.as_no_answer: Nta gisubizo kiri kuri iki gikoresho. Ongera ubaze uri kuri interineti, cyangwa uganire n'umuntu.
texts.as_why_allowed: Ibi biremewe kandi bishobora gusubizwa inyuma.
texts.as_why_confirm: Suzuma ibisobanuro, hanyuma wemeze cyangwa wange.
texts.as_why_fresh_check: Banza, isuzuma ryihuse ko ari wowe.
texts.as_why_hand_over: Umuntu cyangwa umufatanyabikorwa ufite uruhushya ni we ufata icyemezo, bityo byateguriwe bo.
texts.as_why_later: Ibi bisaba umuyoboro n'umuntu cyangwa umufatanyabikorwa. Bizategurwa byoherezwe igihe uzaba uri kuri interineti.
texts.as_why_network: Ibi bireba konti yawe, bityo bitegereje umuyoboro.
texts.as_why_never: Ibi ntibijya bitangwa, kugira ngo urindwe.
texts.as_why_not_registered: LynkAssist ntishobora gukora ibi. Si kimwe mu byo yemerewe gukora.
texts.as_why_role: Uruhare rwawe ntirubyemera. Baza nyiri ubucuruzi.
texts.case_opened: Ikibazo cyoherejwe ku bufasha. Ibisubizo biza mu Biganiro.
texts.demo_people_card: Ibice bya LynkAttend, LynkQueue na LynkSurvey
texts.demo_rate_title: Uruzinduko rwawe rw'uyu munsi rwagenze rute?
texts.find_or_do: Shakisha cyangwa ukore icyo ari cyo cyose
texts.find_or_do_hint: Shakisha ibicuruzwa, abakiriya, ibyatumijwe, raporo, igenamiterere n'ubufasha, cyangwa wandike igikorwa
texts.kp_state_confirmed: Byarangiye: utanga serivisi cyangwa umufatanyabikorwa yabyemeje.
texts.kp_state_failed: Ntibyakunze. Nta kintu cyishyujwe cyangwa cyahinduwe.
texts.kp_state_queued: Byabitswe kuri iki gikoresho kandi bitegereje koherezwa.
texts.match_ok: Imibare irahuye. Iki gikoresho noneho gishobora gukoreshwa.
texts.match_pick_note: Niba nta mubare uhuye, hagarara: hari undi muntu ushobora kuba agerageza kwinjira.
texts.match_pick_title: Kanda umubare ugaragara ku kindi gikoresho
texts.match_show_note: Umuntu uri ku gikoresho gishya akanda umubare umwe n'uwo.
texts.match_show_title: Erekana uyu mubare ku gikoresho gishya
texts.msg_never_ask: LynkOmni ntijya isaba ijambo ry'ibanga, kode cyangwa nimero y'ikarita yawe binyuze mu butumwa.
texts.needs_net: Bikenera murandasi: gusaba kwishyurwa no kohereza ibiganiro.
texts.never_blocks_person: Kwifasha ntibibuza na rimwe kugera ku muntu.
texts.no_articles: Nta nyandiko iriho kuri iyi paji.
texts.ntf_basis_opt_in: Wahisemo kubyakira. Ushobora kubihagarika igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
texts.ntf_basis_safety: Hari umuntu ushobora kuba ari mu kaga, ni yo mpamvu bihora byoherezwa.
texts.ntf_basis_security: Bireba umutekano wa konti yawe, ni yo mpamvu bihora byoherezwa.
texts.ntf_basis_transaction: Ni igice cy'ikintu wakoze cyangwa wasabye.
texts.ntf_can_turn_off: Ushobora kuzimya ubu bwoko mu igenamiterere ry'imenyesha.
texts.ntf_cannot_turn_off: Ubu bwoko ntibushobora kuzimywa kuko bukurinda wowe cyangwa abandi.
texts.pin_locked: Iki gikoresho cyafunzwe nyuma y'imibare y'ibanga myinshi itari yo.
texts.pin_locked_how: Nta kintu cyasibwe. Gifungure ukoresheje kode yawe yo kugarura, uvuye ku kindi gikoresho cyinjiyemo, cyangwa ugarura konti yawe kuri interineti.
texts.pin_wait: Umubare w'ibanga si wo. Ongera ugerageze nyuma y'amasegonda {s}.
texts.pin_wrong: Umubare w'ibanga si wo. Hasigaye kugerageza {n} mbere y'uko igikoresho gifungwa.
texts.ppl_after_payment_help: Bigaragara kuri ecran y'umukiriya nyuma y'uko kwishyura kwemejwe. Gukanda rimwe, si itegeko.
texts.ppl_at_agree_full_id_number: Cyangwa andika nimero yuzuye y'icyangombwa (si IDCN)
texts.ppl_at_agree_text: Nemeye uburyo buri mu itsinda ryanjye. Guha undi PIN cyangwa IDCN yanjye, cyangwa kwandikishiriza undi muntu, ni uburiganya mu kwitabira.
texts.ppl_at_already_in: Wamaze kwiyandikisha. Kanda Andika ko usohotse igihe ugiye.
texts.ppl_at_backup_face_failed: Isura yanze, bityo hakoreshejwe uburyo bukurikira.
texts.ppl_at_backup_face_not_working: Isura ntikora kuri iki gikoresho, bityo hakoreshejwe uburyo bukurikira.
texts.ppl_at_backup_finger_not_working: Urutoki ntirukora kuri iki gikoresho, bityo hakoreshejwe uburyo bukurikira.
texts.ppl_at_bill_note: Habarwa gusa abantu biyandikishije nibura rimwe muri uku kwezi. Abashyitsi ni ubuntu.
texts.ppl_at_cert_note: Uwo ari we wese ashobora kugenzura ko impamyabushobozi ari iy'ukuri akoresheje kode yayo.
texts.ppl_at_cert_tier: Impamyabushobozi ziboneka muri LynkAttend Pro na Max.
texts.ppl_at_checker_note: Abantu bizewe bari aho. Umuntu ntabona na rimwe izina rye bwite ku rutonde.
texts.ppl_at_clock_note: Iyo igikoresho kigarutse ku murongo gifite isaha itari yo, inyandiko zacyo zishyirwaho akamenyetso ngo uzikosore.
texts.ppl_at_correct_note: Ikosora rigumana inyandiko ya kera iruhande rw'inshya.
texts.ppl_at_country_allows: Isura n'Urutoki byemewe muri iki gihugu
texts.ppl_at_device_limit: Iyi gahunda yemerera ibikoresho {n} byo ku muryango.
texts.ppl_at_event_limit: Iyi gahunda yageze ku mubare wayo w'ibikorwa.
texts.ppl_at_fire_note: Abari imbere bose, abakozi n'abashyitsi, bo gushyiraho akamenyetso aho bahurira. Bikora nta interineti.
texts.ppl_at_flag_note: Ibi ni ibimenyetso gusa, si ikirego na rimwe. Ni wowe ufata icyemezo.
texts.ppl_at_group_note: Ishami rimwe cyangwa igikorwa kimwe ni itsinda rimwe rya PIN. Nta PIN itangwa kabiri cyangwa yongera gukoreshwa.
texts.ppl_at_group_warn: Iri tsinda rya PIN rigiye kuzura. Tangira itsinda rishya rya PIN.
texts.ppl_at_guardian: Umwana uri kumwe n'umubyeyi cyangwa umurezi
texts.ppl_at_hand_note: Gusa igihe uburyo bwose bwanze. Impamvu yandikwa buri gihe, kandi ntushobora na rimwe kwiyandikisha ubwawe.
texts.ppl_at_idcn_made: IDCN ikorwa hashingiwe kuri nimero y'icyangombwa.
texts.ppl_at_leave_note: Kwiyandikisha mu kiruhuko cyemewe bishyirwaho ikimenyetso.
texts.ppl_at_limit: Iyi gahunda yemerera abantu {n}. Hitamo gahunda nini kugira ngo wongere abandi.
texts.ppl_at_lock_note: Igikoresho gifunze ntigishobora kongera kwandika uwinjira. Ibikirimo byose birahishwe mu ibanga.
texts.ppl_at_needs_online: Ibi bisaba interineti. Bizakora umuyoboro nugaruka.
texts.ppl_at_no_check_out_rule: Inyandiko igifunguye amasaha 2 akazi karangiye (saa sita z'ijoro iyo nta masaha y'akazi) ishyirwaho "Nta kwandika gusohoka". Umuntu aribubutswa nawe ugakosora isaha.
texts.ppl_at_no_enrolment: Nta cyo kwandikisha kuri IDCN gusa.
texts.ppl_at_not_allowed: Iri tsinda ry'uburyo ntiryemewe muri iki gihugu.
texts.ppl_at_only_added: Igikoresho cyo ku muryango wongeyeho gusa ni cyo gishobora kwandika abinjira.
texts.ppl_at_pin_note: LynkOmni ni yo ikora PIN. Nta muntu uyandika cyangwa uyihitamo.
texts.ppl_at_reader_needed: Uyu muntu akeneye icyuma gisoma igikumwe. Huza icyuma gisoma igikumwe n'iki gikoresho kugira ngo ukomeze.
texts.ppl_at_req_note: Wibutswa nyuma y'iminsi 7, 14 na 25. Nyuma y'iminsi 30 nta gikozwe, amakuru asibwa ubwayo.
texts.ppl_at_sandbox_clock: Igerageza: isaha y'iki gikoresho ntabwo ari yo
texts.ppl_at_sandbox_delete: Igerageza: umuntu asaba ko amakuru ye asibwa
texts.ppl_at_send_note: PIN na IDCN bijyana, bikagera gusa ku muntu ubwe.
texts.ppl_at_set_note: Itsinda ry'uburyo rihitwamo umuntu abyemeye. Buri wese afite IDCN nk'ubwunganizi.
texts.ppl_at_show_note: Igihe cyose PIN yerekanywe cyangwa yoherejwe birandikwa.
texts.ppl_at_too_few: Iki cyangombwa gifite imibare mike cyane. Nyamuneka andika ikindi cyangombwa cy'uyu muntu.
texts.ppl_at_visitor_needed: Andika izina ry'umushyitsi uhitemo uwo asura.
texts.ppl_at_visitor_note: Genzura icyangombwa cy'umushyitsi. Nta foto ifatwa. Nta cyangombwa, umuyobozi agomba kwemera uruzinduko.
texts.ppl_at_wty_in: Wiyandikishije saa {time}. Si wowe? Kanda Si njye.
texts.ppl_at_wty_out: Wanditse ko usohotse saa {time}. Si wowe? Kanda Si njye.
texts.ppl_checker_notice: Reba neza ko umugenzuzi uhitamo ari aho ukorera.
texts.ppl_codes_left: Nimero {n} z'amatike ziteguye kuri iki gikoresho
texts.ppl_door_blocked: PIN yawe yahagaritswe by'agateganyo. Umuyobozi ashobora kugufasha.
texts.ppl_door_offline: Ikora nta interineti. Ibikwa kuri iki gikoresho ikoherezwa iyo umuyoboro ugarutse.
texts.ppl_door_paused: Wagerageje inshuro nyinshi. Tegereza umunota umwe cyangwa ubone umuyobozi.
texts.ppl_door_pin_wrong: Iyo PIN ntizwi hano. Ongera ugerageze.
texts.ppl_good_share: {share}% bavuze ko ari byiza cyangwa byiza cyane, hiyongereyeho cyangwa havuyeho amanota {margin}.

texts.ppl_priority: Abihutirwa: umusaza, utwite cyangwa ufite ubumuga
texts.ppl_qu_balance: Umuntu 1 wihutirwa nyuma ya buri bandi {n}.

texts.ppl_qu_fair: Hamagara ukurikira bikurikiza urutonde rutabera. Abakozi ntibahitamo na rimwe ukurikira.
texts.ppl_qu_follow: Sikana kugira ngo ukurikirane umurongo kuri telefoni yawe.
texts.ppl_qu_forecast_line: Ejo {from} kugeza {to} hazaba urujya n'uruza rwinshi kuri {section}.

texts.ppl_qu_free_limit: Amatike y'ubuntu y'uku kwezi yashize. Gahunda yishyurwa irakenewe.
texts.ppl_qu_history_note: Buri gikorwa kirabikwa. Inyandiko ntizihindurwa na rimwe mu ibanga.

texts.ppl_qu_late_help: Ndatinda bigusubiza inyuma imyanya {n}, rimwe gusa.
texts.ppl_qu_late_used: Ndatinda byamaze gukoreshwa kuri iyi tike.

texts.ppl_qu_plan_send_to: Kohereza ku kindi gice bisaba gahunda yishyurwa.
texts.ppl_qu_plan_way: Ubu buryo bwo kwinjira mu murongo busaba gahunda yishyurwa.

texts.ppl_qu_public_join: Ushobora kwinjira mu murongo uhereye hano.

texts.ppl_qu_put_back_late: Hashize iminota irenga {m}. Hakenewe itike nshya.
texts.ppl_qu_qr_changes: Iyi kode ihinduka buri minota mike.
texts.ppl_qu_reports_by_email: Gahunda yawe ifite raporo zuzuye, zoherezwa no kuri imeyili.
texts.ppl_qu_reports_custom: Gahunda yawe ifite raporo zihariye no gukurura byuzuye.
texts.ppl_qu_reports_daily_summary: Gahunda yawe yerekana incamake ya buri munsi.
texts.ppl_qu_reports_full: Gahunda yawe ifite raporo zuzuye ku gice, konteri, umukozi n'isaha.

texts.state_error_body: Nta kintu cyatakaye. Ongera ugerageze, cyangwa usabe ubufasha.

texts.state_permission_body: Saba nyir'ubu bucuruzi kuguha ubu burenganzira.
texts.state_sync_pending_body: Impinduka zawe zibitswe hano kandi zizoherezwa iyo murandasi igarutse.

texts.support_connecting: Turimo kuguhuza n'umukozi wa LynkOmni Support.
texts.switch_side_group: Aho ukorera cyangwa iduka ryawe ryo kuri murandasi
texts.username_bad_character: Inyuguti a kugeza kuri z, imibare, utudomo n'umurongo wo hasi gusa.

texts.view_waits: Uburyo bushya butangira nyuma y'iyi ntambwe.
